# 1. Case analysis


* Analysis of the dashboard reports reveals that the GMV in this case increased significantly after July 2015 and has been on a continuous upward trend;

* In the comparison across provinces, the GMV of Guangdong Province and Jiangsu Province far exceeds the average; in the comparison across products, the GMV of Mountaineering 20, Road 15, and Road 25 products is significantly ahead of other products.
